question: Who among the following was the leader of 1857 revolt in Ramgarh state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avantibai Lodhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Avantibai Lodhi** was a prominent freedom fighter who led the revolt of 1857 in the Ramgarh state.
 
• She was the queen of the Ramgarh state and is known for her bravery and leadership during the revolt.
 
• Avantibai Lodhi played a significant role in organizing the local people and leading them against the British forces.
 
• She is remembered as a symbol of resistance and valor in Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1857 Revolt (First War of Indian Independence)**

 
 
• The revolt of 1857, also known as the First War of Indian Independence, was a major, but ultimately unsuccessful, uprising in India against the rule of the British East India Company.
 
• It began on 10 May 1857 with a mutiny of sepoys of the Company's army in the town of Meerut and soon escalated into other mutinies and civilian rebellions largely in the upper Gangetic plain and central India.
 
• The revolt posed a considerable threat to British power in that region, and was contained only with the fall of Gwalior on 20 June 1858.
 
• The rebellion led to the dissolution of the British East India Company and the reorganization of the army, the financial system, and the administration in India.
 
 
 
• **Key Figures of the 1857 Revolt**
 
 
• **Rani Lakshmibai:** The queen of Jhansi, she was one of the leading figures of the revolt and became a symbol of resistance to British rule.
 
• **Bahadur Shah Zafar:** The last Mughal emperor, he was declared the symbolic leader of the revolt.
 
• **Tantia Tope:** A close ally of Rani Lakshmibai, he was one of the most notable generals of the revolt.
 
• **Kunwar Singh:** The ruler of Jagdishpur, he led the rebellion in Bihar.
